examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band as the careers page places it: the headline and wide description over a strip of six office photographs that scrolls continuously and pauses on hover or focus. Edit the props in the Controls panel — a band with no photos renders nothing at all. WebKit ships no editorial media, so the photos here are the neutral `@aziontech/webkit/assets/placeholder-image.svg`; pass your own image URLs.
